evidence: Single capital pool with a TWO-STATE router, not parallel sleeves: DDDD() takes the 20 smallest circulating-cap names of 399101, normalises their 1-day returns and returns (variance, mean); consistent() sets g.type='偷鸡' when variance < 0.02 and mean > 0, else '摸狗'. 偷鸡 = choose_stocks -> filter_high_price_stock (last price < 10) + get_peg (roe>0.15, roa>0.10, order_by market_cap.asc), 10 slots, held for a fixed g.Counterattack_Days=30 before forced exit. 摸狗 = get_rank(g.etf_pool) by MOM (25-day weighted log-slope x R^2) over 4 ETFs (518880/513100/159915/510180), hold 1. Risk: 0.9 stop plus a martingale 补跌加仓 into the 3 worst holdings. Header declares a clone of post/49001 偷鸡摸狗策略 (author MarioC) — a lineage the library has not registered; the MOM helper is the corpus-wide 轮动 idiom and is NOT lineage evidence by itself.

mechanism: 历史涨停基因 + 启动点筛选的小市值周频 3 只
evidence: SCREENS BY limit-up history, does NOT chase one: filter_by_limit_up_history counts close==high_limit days over a 250-day window and keeps count>=2; filter_by_start_point requires the bar BEFORE the latest limit-up to be a down day on below-average volume (离上一次涨停启动点); then order_by(valuation.market_cap.asc()) to a 200-name pool, one name per sw_l1 industry, g.stock_num=3, bought weekly at 10:15 — and the sell side SKIPS a holding that is at high_limit (trade_logic / check_limit_open: only sells 'if last_price < high_limit'), i.e. it holds limit-ups rather than buying them. This is the 涨停基因 sub-lineage the 打板短线 page registers (base c9e0451d_带涨停基因的小市值, 'N年涨停次数 + 按离上一次涨停启动点的距离排序, 周频持有, 每行业1只, 最小市值'). Header declares descent: '克隆并重构自 .../post/64877 【2026新版】涨停基因+小市值增强策略（基于Loylee原版深度优化）'. ⚠ Rewritten, not copied, so Jaccard abstains; the alternative home is 小市值 (that page's 规模因子 edge is the same floor), which is a human call.

sourceFile: strategies/2026-10-12_7_8_极限回撤_用架构解耦重构多策略动态路由-c4f480e3.py
mechanism: 单只纳指ETF：三态分类后海龟突破与RSI反转切换，吊灯止损
entry: daily 14:50 (order_target_value, deliberately late to avoid the open)
evidence: g.security = '513100.XSHG' is the ONLY instrument — despite the title, '多策略动态路由' is three signal generators on one asset, not a multi-sleeve book. before_market_open: talib.EMA(close,90) trend + ATR(14)/SMA(ATR,90) ratio give regime 0/1/2 and g.strategy_weights, plus a volatility position scaler (1.2/vol_ratio). market_trade at 14:50: strategy A = 30-day Donchian breakout with a 10-day volume confirmation, strategy B = asymmetric RSI(14) (buy<32, sell>50), weighted sum clipped to [0,1], and a 3xATR chandelier stop on g.highest_since_buy; rebalances only when |target-current| > 10% of equity. Mechanistically adjacent to 趋势技术's champion branch (a single-instrument MA timer) but shares no code with that family's base 33b1b1e3 (沪深300 RPS cross-section + MA20 gate), so NEW rather than a lineage claim. ⚠ No set_option('avoid_future_data') and no set_slippage in this book, and the 14:50 signals read get_bars(...)[-1] on the in-progress daily bar.
